name_reason: Compliant data_fd2_<domain=graphics>_<descriptor> name. Descriptor 'circle_band_radius_scale' correctly reflects the use (band half-width scale factor) and the scalar nature. The '_16' suffix is NOT a Ghidra address residue: address 0x50208 contains no '16', and the value is 1.6 -- the suffix encodes the literal value 1.6 (decimal point dropped), matching the consistent value-suffix convention of the sibling constants in gfxtab.c (_div_10 = 10.0, _neg8 = -8.0). Datatype-as-scalar is implied by 'scale'.
purpose: Band half-width scale factor (1.6) used by fd2_render_filled_circle_band_anim to size the fully-filled middle section of the AoE filled-circle visual.
logic_summary: Single reader fd2_render_filled_circle_band_anim @ 0x220a3 computes half_width = trunc(radius_factor * 1.6) via x87 FMUL m64 [0x50208]; __CHP forces round-toward-zero (RC=11) before FISTP so the product truncates toward zero (the Ghidra ROUND() macro is misleading). The half_width then drives left/right screen-edge clamping for the row-fill loop.
element_semantics: Single IEEE-754 double scalar = 1.6 (bytes 9a 99 99 99 99 99 f9 3f LE = 0x3FF999999999999A). Multiplier applied to the caller's integer radius factor to derive the band half-width in workspace pixels.
